tracks.name: Bounded cross-system disputed-predictor forum audit
acceptance: Recover and reconcile project's existing 16-tradition system catalog and classify each distinct method as natal traits, timing, compatibility, contemplation, or calculation only; no new unbounded re-invention

For all currently registered 16 candidate claims, record original positive assertion, pre-existing qualifications, real-world contrary and supporting evidence where obtainable, and read mode; unmapped/evidence gaps explicitly unknown

Make at most THREE documented, targeted broad search sweeps under the current owner-approved scope, with the present pilot as sweep one and two further independent balance/source-verification sweeps; a further major scope change requires a separately approved new phase
Require at least two distinct attributable first-person experiences for high-priority claims when discoverable; otherwise report insufficient evidence, never fabricate numerator or denominator
Cross-check high-impact literal source conditions against original tradition passages before calling an anecdote a source falsification
Deliver sortable triage of source claims by interpretability, clinical/high-impact consequence, source conflict and testability; report successes, failures, ambiguous cases, and unsearched systems
Do NOT assert true complaint frequency or empirical failure rates from purpose-selected posts
tracks.current_evidence: Three bounded source-search passes saved and independently checked: 22 claims, 59 selected source observations, 49 normalized distinct source discussions/pages, 0 representative denominators or verified prospective natal forecasts; missing sources/counterconditions explicitly disclosed.
tracks.notes: The count of three search sweeps is an ASSISTANT_INFERENCE reversible budget to prevent indefinite searching, not a hard scientific adequacy threshold.

tracks.name: Private participant profile and disconfirming cases
acceptance: Preserve respondent's original C01–C10 answers privately with immutable hash
Record the owner's 2026-11-21 confirmation of the five-part generalized context-qualified description separately from detailed unconfirmed subtraits
Preserve observed self-reported exceptions, uncertainty, third-party allegations as allegations, and non-equivalence of respondent belief vs actual reliable cue
Build versioned profile features, source-neutral, before any new score; do not auto-promote anecdotes to hard general traits

tracks.name: Multiple source-complete HD and Western personality interpretations
acceptance: Freeze separately original HD types/profiles/gates/channels/Cross and full source qualification, with exclusion/quarantine of unvalidated safety/Authority processes
Freeze separate Ptolemy III.13 governor, applying aspects, dignity/sect/angles and contrary testimony; if incomplete, label school rule not score-eligible
Freeze separate Lilly Renaissance manners significator, ASC ruler vs manners ruler, sect and house conditions; if incomplete, label not score-eligible
Freeze modern psychological Western aspects/outer chart factors separately and name interpretive flexibility and observational specificity
Record rule scope, observable behavior, countercase, dependency cluster, opposing evidence and nonastrological baseline BEFORE seeing new model fit/rank
Any missing source condition stays unresolved rather than using a convenient simplification or alternate model after result

tracks.name: Full candidate chart comparison and stop
acceptance: Use verified Swiss Ephemeris and exact HD boundary engine/century cache, no undocumented 14-state pruning from old HD-only scorer

Compute every candidate in declared comparison universe or publish valid score upper bounds; for 15-min Western grid report sampling and exact near-HD boundary uncertainty instead of implying continuous completeness

Produce separate HD, Ptolemaic, Lilly and modern-psychological human-fit comparison reports with conflicts, dependence caps and zero-score quarantined predictors, plus optional explicitly labeled combined sensitivity analysis
Compare actual recorded chart against all material alternatives and show highest scoring as well as strong contradictory hypotheses

Release truthful rank if eligible complete source rules exist; else terminal no-defensible-unique-ranking report with exact missing dependencies and honest negative outcome rather than indefinite model-shopping
Verify outputs, immutability of historical scores and privacy-safe repository commit; independent reviewer where feasible but not a new arbitrary blocker

tracks.name: Gemini independent response and disagreement reconciliation
acceptance: Recover actual Gemini prompt/model/candidate set/result where available; distinguish earlier 10-chart Western-only result from full-HD century research
Send minimally disclosing explicit neutral objections and identical chart summaries to Gemini if an authorized connected route exists; capture exact returned text/model/turn time and raw status
If no Gemini route, save send-ready prompt and mark NOT_SENT_NO_GEMINI_RESPONSE, not fabricate agreement, not treat a route problem as a project-completion blocker
When Gemini replies, freeze its comparison before changing model, then juxtapose any point-by-point objections and revised predictions
tracks.captured_route: Owner pasted Gemini textual response in ChatGPT, NOT a direct writable ChatGPT->Gemini connection

tracks.name: Optional separately scoped scientific chart-to-person predictive validation
acceptance: Pre-register blind question/score/candidate/endpoint/time and independent birth data, matched decoys and chart-free baseline
Evaluate untouched participants without knowing chart details or predicted answers; explicit matched and broad chance/null results
Report uncertainty, sample size and failures; do not promote old owner retrospective matches as prospective accuracy
